title: Business Plan and Pitch Deck Collection
description: An archival collection of business plans, pitch decks, editable presentation materials, and competition-oriented project examples for the Challenge Cup, entrepreneurship competitions, innovation projects, and project presentations. The repository README documents the collection structure, recommended reading path, file formats, and responsible reuse guidance. The materials are preserved as research and teaching references; users should verify claims, sources, market figures, and permissions before adapting any item.
